translation_exact: Regarding Cylon, I have nothing certain to say about the precise reason why they dedicated a bronze statue of him, though he plotted to seize tyranny. However, my inference is based on these points: he was supremely handsome in appearance, gained considerable fame by winning the Olympic victory in the double foot-race, and married a daughter of Theagenes, who ruled as tyrant over Megara.
